title: Vogue World of Ginny Doll Going Shopping 8in Poseable Vinyl NIB
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: The Vogue World of Ginny Doll - Going Shopping is an 8” poseable vinyl doll from 1984. This vintage doll features blonde hair in wavy, curly, or varying styles, blue eyes that open and close, and a light complexion. The doll comes in original packaging and includes 7 pieces, making it a collectible item for fans of the Ginny Doll franchise. With a Caucasian ethnicity and suitable for all occasions, this fashion doll is a nostalgic piece from the 1980s that captures the essence of the era.
